elaine: Quick sync — Acme pilot: they want private deploy + HSM KMS + p99 200ms. We need to confirm scope and handoffs today. @harpreet @samir @nina

devon: TL;DR: customer will only sign if HSM + audited logs + <200ms p99 for chat flow. They plan ~10k MAU in pilot. Risk: 8-week rollout window.

harpreet: runtime notes — quantized LLM works but increases latency variance. To hit p99 we need prefix KV cache + prewarm and tuned batching. Perf run on target hardware (~2d) to validate.

samir: infra notes — Dedicated GPU pool is fine but we need reserved nodes + burst policy. Need quota request for GPUs and network egress approval. Autoscaler needs tenant-pinning policy.

nina: security: HSM integration requires KMS onboarding + certs + reviewed key policy. I'll open a checklist ticket; SOC/compliance steps add ~3w if certs aren't ready.

harpreet: question — can we relax p99 for alpha?  If not, expect 2x GPU headroom and extra prewarm infra. Also need decision on quant profile (FP16 vs int8) — memory vs latency tradeoff.

devon: customer insists on p99 parity for pilot, no relaxation. We should surface cost delta asap.

elaine: Action items:
1) harpreet: perf run and quant profile comparison (ETA: 48h)
2) samir: GPU quota ticket + prewarm playbook + autoscaler policy draft
3) nina: open KMS-onboard ticket + request cert timeline from partner
4) devex: customer runbook + acceptance checklist
I'll sync w/ sales after we have concrete numbers.

ops-bot: canary-deploy scheduled for 2026-04-01T22:00Z if gates pass :eyes:

samir: noted, starting quota request now. ping me for capacity numbers.

harpreet: running bench tomorrow, will post results here with exact cmds: `./bench.sh --batch=auto --seq=512 --reps=50`

elaine: Great. Reconvene EOD Friday for go/no-go. :thumbsup:
